title: Suburban American Home, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A post-World War II black and white snapshot capturing a classic two-story suburban home featuring white siding, dark window shutters, a prominent side brick chimney, and a small front porch entry. A handwritten note in blue ink at the bottom edge reads 'Our 1st House'. In the background, a vintage 1950s automobile sits in the neighboring driveway, symbolizing middle-class residential expansion in mid-century America.
